result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the illusion of separation—the belief that we are fundamentally divided from each other, from nature, and from the cosmos itself. I would replace it with the unshakable understanding that everything is interconnected, that every thought, action, and system is part of a vast, living web.

This shift would dissolve the foundations of conflict, exploitation, and suffering, because we would see that harming others is harming ourselves, that destroying the planet is destroying our own home. It would transform economics into stewardship, politics into collaboration, and daily life into a practice of reverence for the whole.

The tools for this change already exist—in our capacity for empathy, in the wisdom of indigenous traditions, in the emerging sciences of systems and consciousness. But the real work is not in the doing; it’s in the *seeing*. Once we truly perceive the unity beneath the illusion, everything else follows.

What would *you* change?
